recommendations.recommendation: Address critical baseline gaps in HR experience and employment law knowledge
action_items: Acquire foundational knowledge of Australian employment law, National Employment Standards (NES), and Modern Awards through short courses or certifications (e.g., Fair Work fundamentals, Modern Awards interpretation)
Emphasize transferable skills from case management and client liaison work, particularly experience conducting assessments, developing plans, and navigating complex stakeholder relationships
Consider seeking volunteer or project-based opportunities to gain exposure to HR documentation, employment contracts, or workplace compliance in small business settings

recommendations.recommendation: Emphasize key transferable strengths from community services and client-facing work
action_items: Highlight strong communication and stakeholder management skills demonstrated through working directly with diverse clients, building trust, and navigating challenging conversations
Emphasize experience managing multiple clients simultaneously and juggling competing priorities in fast-paced community services environment
Showcase problem-solving capabilities through de-escalation, conflict resolution, and providing client-centred solutions under complex circumstances
